name: [DRAGONFLY] Raise an Ant Colony 🐜
desc:
🐜 Grow your colony from one queen to an underground army!

⛏️ Dig tunnels and hide your nest deep below
🥚 Lay eggs and hatch Workers, Majors and Drones
🍎 Gather food to grow a bigger, stronger colony

Team up with your friends and defend each other when attacked!
Declare war on rival colonies, take down their queen and earn DNA! 🧬

Buy upgrades, unlock new species and dominate the big world of these tiny insects!⚔️ 

Join the group + like the game for a free harvester ant!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/150958400/Antventure

llm.loop: dig tunnels and lay eggs -> hatch worker/major/drone ants -> gather food to grow the colony -> raid rival colonies for DNA -> unlock species and upgrades
llm.objectives: grow your colony from one queen to an underground army and dominate rival colonies
llm.progression: colony size, DNA, upgrades, species unlocks
llm.instructions: dig tunnels, hide your nest, lay eggs, gather food, team up to defend, declare war on rival colonies and take down their queen
unique: ant colony management with team PvP wars against rival colonies
llm.thumbnails: crowned ant queen icon, Day 1 vs Day 100 tunnel growth, 1 VS 100 ant swarm, ant colony with gold
llm.complexity_notes: diggable terrain, swarm unit AI, colony management, PvP raids, multiple species
